name: buninu
description: Buninu is a portable, self-bootstrapping Unix-like userspace built on Bun that runs across operating systems

command.default: echo Welcome to Buninu, Try: glow apps/cmdlist, Help: buninu-help
command.android: if command -v libmain.so >/dev/null 2>&1; then libmain.so; else printf '%s\n' '# Welcome to Buninu Android' '- Try: glow apps/cmdlist' '- Help: buninu-help'; fi
